notes: Every case is a new chart, the maps registered afresh; animation false; a tooltip hides at once and sits at [5, 5].
A click is mousemove, mousedown, mouseup and click at one point; a drag mousemove and mousedown at the first point, a mousemove to each further one, mouseup and click at the last.
After every step: chart._onframe() and a display-list refresh.
The heatmap canvas is this script's reference raster (see the header); the colouring of it is upstream's.

cases.note: a map series on its own geo: the data's names (one not on the map, one '-'), a data item with its own itemStyle and label; the regions not in the data appended; G's echartsStyle merged into its appended item; labels on the NaN regions only (no legend); hover through the regions; the default tooltip
a continuous visualMap colours the regions (the data visual over the areaColor); a NaN region keeps the areaColor
a piecewise visualMap with outOfRange: the pieces colour the regions

three map series on one map with a legend: the statistic (mapValueCalculation of the first, 'average'), the legend symbols with their offsets and labels; a region tooltip names the series with a value there; the legend switches the first series off -- the second draws the map, the statistic now the second's 'sum' default; then the third off too
mapValueCalculation max / min on the first series of a group; showLegendSymbol false (a legend, no symbols: every region labelled by showLabel)

a map series on a geo component (geoIndex): the geo draws the regions with the series' data -- the visual fill, labels always (the geo's), the regions the series' items (events and tooltip the series')

the series' own geo laid out from the first declared series: a box, zoom and centre, aspectScale, nameMap (merged over the group); a second series on the same map with other layout options shares that geo; layoutCenter + layoutSize on another map
selectedMode 'multiple' on a map series: clicks select through the series' data (selectchanged); the legacy mapToggleSelect; the select action by name; selectedMode false: a click selects nothing
selectedMode true (the default) is single: a second click moves the selection
labels from the series: show with a template '{a}|{b}|{c}', an emphasis formatter, a data item's own label; hover shows the emphasis text
focus 'self' on a map series: hovering a region blurs the others; highlight / downplay by name
roam on a map series: a drag and a wheel dispatch geoRoam with componentType 'series' and the seriesId; a geoRoam by seriesIndex; the symbols follow
scatter and effectScatter on a geo: the points through dataToPoint (a string lng is NaN: not drawn); hover a point; a geoRoam pan and zoom move the points (updateTransform)
a geo that clips, zoomed: a scatter (clip true by default) keeps only the points in the geo's view rect (getArea(0.1), not roamed); one with clip false keeps all; a later zoom changes which
two geos: series by geoIndex and geoId; a series naming no geo is on the first
lines on a geo: two-point lines with curveness, a polyline series; after a pan the lines follow
pies on a geo: the centre a coordinate (center as the coord, then coord with a percentage center that is not used), the radius a percentage of the chart; after a zoom the pies move
custom on a geo: api.coord and api.size (dataToCoordSize: the two-point spans through dataToPoint), params.coordSys {type 'geo', the data rect, zoom}; after a pan renderItem runs again
a graph on a geo: the nodes at their [lng, lat] values, the edges between them; after a pan
a heatmap on a geo: HeatmapLayer -- the brush (pointSize + blurSize), every point drawn at its alpha (the visualMap's normalizer), the alpha coloured through the gradient; a piecewise visualMap after
brush with geoIndex (its own brushStyle: the default one is the skin colour in the port): a rect area by coordRange selects the scatter points inside; then a polygon by coordRange
examples map-usa: the USA map with the special areas, a continuous visualMap, the map series
examples geo-choropleth-scatter: a scatter on the Iceland geo and a map series hosted on the same geo (geoIndex)
examples geo-graph: a graph on the Swiss geo
examples effectScatter-map on the hand-made 'china': a scatter and an effectScatter on the geo
